scan.help:
Dry-run: list media items missing trailers.

Args:
    ctx: Typer context carrying AppCtx (config available via ctx.obj.config).
    disk: Optional disk ID filter.
    category: Optional category ID filter.
    since: Optional ISO date lower bound for item age.
    limit: Optional max item count.
    no_refresh: Skip library cache refresh when True.
    level: Trailer level filter (show / season / both).
    season: Specific season number; implies --level=season.

download.help:
Discover and download missing trailers.

Args:
    ctx: Typer context carrying AppCtx (config available via ctx.obj.config).
    disk: Optional disk ID filter.
    category: Optional category ID filter.
    since: Optional ISO date lower bound for item age.
    limit: Optional max item count.
    dry_run: When True, show candidates without downloading.
    no_refresh: Skip library cache refresh when True.
    level: Trailer level filter (show / season / both).
    season: Specific season number; implies --level=season.
download.would_attempt: Would attempt to download trailers for {{items}} items.

audit.help:
Audit existing trailers (canonical command).

Runs four checks per trailer:
1. Existence - trailer file present at the expected placement path.
2. Size - file size >= config.trailers.filters.min_file_size_bytes.
3. Extension - file suffix in config.trailers.filters.allowed_extensions.
4. Playable (opt-in, --deep) - ffprobe returns non-zero duration.

Failures report a category: missing, undersized, wrong_extension, unplayable.
Exit codes: 0 if all pass, 2 if any functional check fails,
4 if a --deep ffprobe call errors out (probe itself broken).

Args:
    ctx: Typer context carrying AppCtx (config available via ctx.obj.config).
    disk: Optional disk ID filter.
    category: Optional category ID filter.
    since: Optional ISO date lower bound for item age.
    deep: When True, run ffprobe playability check (expensive).
    level: Trailer level filter (show / season / both).
    season: Specific season number; implies --level=season.
audit.ffprobe_error: ffprobe error: one or more probes failed (exit 4).

purge.help:
Remove orphan trailers whose media video is gone; heal index gaps.

A trailer is orphan only when its media directory holds no real media video
(FS truth) — present media, even if absent from the index, is never touched.
A present-but-unindexed media dir is instead re-indexed (via the scanner's
single-dir stage), so ``purge`` writes to ``library.db`` on a real run.

When --include-state is set, after the filesystem purge completes call
state_store.purge_orphans() and log the count in the CLI output.

Args:
    ctx: Typer context carrying AppCtx (config available via ctx.obj.config).
    disk: Optional disk ID filter.
    since: Optional ISO date lower bound for item age.
    dry_run: When True, show orphans without deleting.
    include_state: When True, also call state_store.purge_orphans().
    level: Trailer level filter (show / season / both).
    season: Specific season number; implies --level=season.
purge.would_reindex: Would re-index {{gaps}} present media dir(s) missing from the index.
purge.would_wipe_state: Would also wipe orphan state entries (--include-state).
purge.reindexed: Re-indexed {{healed}} present media dir(s) that were missing from the index.
purge.locked: Another trailers process is running; try again later.

opt.disk: Restrict to one disk by ID (e.g. Disk1).
opt.no_refresh_scan: Use cached library scan even if stale.
opt.level_list: Which trailer levels to list: show | season | both. Season-level is silently ignored when seasons.enabled is False.
opt.level_process: Which trailer levels to process: show | season | both. Season-level is silently ignored when seasons.enabled is False.
opt.level_audit: Which trailer levels to audit: show | season | both. Season-level is silently ignored when seasons.enabled is False.
opt.level_purge: Which trailer levels to purge: show | season | both. Season-level is silently ignored when seasons.enabled is False.
opt.season: Target a specific season number (1-indexed). Implies --level=season.
opt.dry_run_download: Show what would be downloaded without doing it.
opt.dry_run_purge: Show what would be purged without doing it.
opt.include_state: Also wipe orphan state entries via state_store.purge_orphans().
